main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess next-3-bar return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid cases, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 with mean excess return > 0; reject: slope t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return (long) on the same cases

decided_by: The plan's minimum of 200 grid cases with a positive forecast on at least 100 distinct days is not reached (280 cases on 78 days).
reading: The slope is from an OLS of excess return on forecast with an intercept, its t from a day-clustered (CR1) sandwich variance, the normal drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 3-bar grid return over all its windows, and grid bars without a full 3-bar return inside their window are left out.
